description: A profile sets both `model: profile-explicit-model` and a `routing: high` pin on the same effect: an effect's own or a profile's `model:` makes it explicit, and an explicit effect never consults its pin or opt-out (settled ruling 8). meta.model is the profile's model override, model_reason: "explicit", and meta.complexity.band is the effect's own scored band ("low"), not the pinned "high" row -- proving the pin was never looked at.
